doc: loopSides/loopRoute were executed from the-bastion's backend/layout.py _route loop branch (LOOP_REACH, the top/right hook off a multiplicity box's own corner), 2026-09-16, generalised from the one corner it hard-coded to all four. The worked box (100,100,200x88) at reach 48 is the pinned example from the design brief; the same box carries all four corners at t=0.5, the top-right corner again at an uneven split (t_out=0.75, t_in=0.25) and a smaller reach (36), and a non-square box at a different origin (300,150,140x50) exercises a corner away from (0,0).
